headline: Fastest in program history at Woodward Park
body: The girls ran the fastest team time in Monte Vista history on the Woodward Park course on Saturday, finishing sixth overall and first among Division 2 schools. Kaylie O'Connell, Nadya Makarova and Ava Padilla ran 17:33, 17:40 and 18:04 respectively. Those three runners now rank second, third and fifth in school history at Woodward Park.

headline: All 31 Mustangs improved at Mid-Season Mania, led by freshman Arthur Tochilnik in 10:10.7.
body: All 31 athletes who ran both 3200m time trials went faster than they did in August. Arthur Tochilnik broke Monte Vista's freshman record in the 3200m, running 10:10.7 and finishing as the top freshman in the field.

headline: Four personal bests for the varsity boys at Haystack
body: Ethan Chen, Arthur Tochilnik, Devin Kapoor and Dimitri Liveris all ran personal bests on the Hayward High School course on Saturday. Chen led the team in 15:54, finishing 42nd in the boys varsity 3 mile.

headline: Kotamraju fourth at the EBAL Championships
body: Rohan Kotamraju ran 15:26.6 for fourth place in the varsity boys race at Newhall Park, Monte Vista's top finisher in the race. The boys placed fourth as a team with 120 points.
image_alt: Rohan Kotamraju runs across the grass toward the camera at the 2025 NCS Championships, in a Monte Vista singlet and red shorts, a runner in purple just behind him and spectators lining the course.

headline: Girls win the EBAL Championship
body: Kaylie O'Connell, Ava Padilla and Nadya Makarova ran the whole race together and jogged in side by side, taking the top three places without racing each other for the win. Monte Vista won the league title with 29 points at Newhall Park on Saturday. Brooke Ennen placed ninth and Olivia Mustin fourteenth.
